title: Qi'ra
description: As one of the scrumrats on Corellia who grew up working scams and pulling jobs for Lady Proxima in the streets of Coronet City, Qi'ra learned from an early age who not to trust. After a failed escape attempt with Han Solo, the calculating woman managed to escape Corellia, joining the ranks of Crimson Dawn, where she ultimately became the trusted lieutenant of Dryden Vos. A survivor by nature, she kept her sabacc cards close to her vest and looked out only for herself. Despite being so trusted, she turned on Dryden Vos and took over Crimson Dawn.
